cipher.name: KeyboardRowShiftCipher
cipher.idea: A substitution cipher based on shifting keys horizontally on a standard QWERTY keyboard. Each letter is replaced by the letter immediately to its right in the same keyboard row. The rows wrap around: 'p' wraps to 'q', 'l' wraps to 'a', and 'm' wraps to 'z'. Case is preserved, and non-alphabetic characters (digits, spaces, punctuation) remain completely unchanged.
cipher.encrypt_rules:
To encrypt, replace each letter with the letter immediately to its right on a standard QWERTY keyboard row, preserving case. The rows wrap around horizontally:
- Row 1: q -> w -> e -> r -> t -> y -> u -> i -> o -> p -> q
- Row 2: a -> s -> d -> f -> g -> h -> j -> k -> l -> a
- Row 3: z -> x -> c -> v -> b -> n -> m -> z
Non-alphabetic characters (spaces, punctuation, digits) are left unchanged.
cipher.decrypt_rules:
To decrypt, replace each letter with the letter immediately to its left on a standard QWERTY keyboard row, preserving case. The rows wrap around horizontally:
- Row 1: q -> p -> o -> i -> u -> y -> t -> r -> e -> w -> q
- Row 2: a -> l -> k -> j -> h -> g -> f -> d -> s -> a
- Row 3: z -> m -> n -> b -> v -> c -> x -> z
Non-alphabetic characters (spaces, punctuation, digits) are left unchanged.
